summary.access_class: INTERNAL_PAPER_ONLY_KEYLESS_PUBLIC_GETS; no API key, no account, no order routing; the only emitted action type is TARGET_INTENT plus internal virtual fills

modules.events.py: plan section 8 record contract; strict validate (all 32 required fields, no extras); event_id = first 32 lowercase hex of sha256("PROSPECTIVE-SHADOW-V1|family_id|arm_id|scheduled_decision_utc"); DATA_BLOCKED event builder consumes the same deterministic id
modules.ledger.py: append-only JSONL per sleeve under runtime root (default results/prospective_shadow_v1/, gitignored); O_APPEND single write + fsync + mandatory read-back verification; duplicate event_id skipped idempotently; partial/garbled line raises LedgerCorruptError and is NEVER truncated; ledger_digest = sha256 over raw bytes
modules.accounting.py: SleeveAccount: isolated 100,000-USDT sleeve; equity == cash + sum(qty x mark) asserted on every mutation (fill conservation = mark-to-market on pre-fill qty + fee once + slippage once); two cost books LINEAGE_COST and CURRENT_CONSERVATIVE_COST per plan section 6 over identical quantities (primary book drives cash/equity; equity_view(book) exposes other books); funding booked ONCE while held with ts_opened <= fundingTime < ts_closed, positive rate long pays / short receives; missing mark => UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED mark-gap state, never interpolated; no margin/leverage: fills exceeding sleeve cash or gross-above-equity raise InsufficientCashError and refuse pre-mutation; decision/order_intent/fill/closed_position counters separate; fill convention: buy ref + ticks*tick, sell ref - ticks*tick, fee on reference notional
modules.risk.py: caps passed as config parsed from identity manifest verbatim parameters (numbers or raw YAML lines); CARRY 0.80/1.00/0.10/0.20 and PREMFADE 0.125..0.30 built directly from the frozen manifest; ILLIQ dollar/beta-neutral rule requires numeric tolerances from config (fail-closed RiskConfigError otherwise); check_and_apply blocks the whole event on any violation and records pre/post target
modules.scheduler.py: weekly Monday 00:00Z (illiq_amihud, basislv_premfade) and daily 00:00Z (xsect_fund_carry); pending_decisions pure (start inclusive, end exclusive); run_once idempotency loop skips event_ids already in the ledger, executes chronologically, converts DataBlocked into DATA_BLOCKED records under the SAME deterministic event_id; heartbeat returns last_scheduled_event / last_completed_event / ledger_byte_count
modules.data_feed.py: PIT interface + keyless GET-only urllib client restricted to the data-manifest allowlist (/fapi/v1/klines, /futures/data/basis, /fapi/v1/fundingRate, /fapi/v1/time, /fapi/v1/exchangeInfo); feature bar eligible iff open+interval < decision; virtual fill = first completed bar strictly after decision (mutating the decision bar's own close cannot change the fill); late/missing/failed fetch raises DataBlocked; every fetch records {url, fetched_at_utc, response_sha256} and compose_data_snapshot_digest folds them deterministically
modules.no_order.py: TARGET_INTENT dataclass + pure emit_target_intent; assert_no_order_surface recursively scans package source for forbidden literals (venue SDKs, order verbs, credential reads, environment secret reads) and raises fail-closed; forbidden literals are assembled from fragments so the scanner's own source stays clean; no_order_proof = {emitted_action_types: [TARGET_INTENT], scan_digest}
modules.combined.py: read-only equal-capital view over plain snapshots (no mutable references); strict sum at valid marks; any sleeve gap or missing point => combined gap UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED with no interpolation; pairwise return correlation fails closed on gaps/misalignment/short windows; same-symbol/same-direction overlap; additive gross/net/btc_beta (no cross-sleeve netting)

key_design_decisions: event_id rule: sha256 over 'PROSPECTIVE-SHADOW-V1|{family_id}|{arm_id}|{scheduled_decision_utc}', first 32 lowercase hex; enforced by the record validator itself, so a record whose id does not derive from its identity fields is invalid

DATA_BLOCKED records consume the deterministic event_id; a retry after data arrives finds the id present and skips - the blocked decision is never re-executed on late data (PIT-honest) and never duplicated

fill conservation invariant: equity_after - equity_before == mark_to_market(pre-fill qty, ref vs old mark) - fee - slippage, asserted on every fill; funding asserts cf pass-through; a failed assert raises IDENTITY_MISMATCH

primary cost book (CURRENT_CONSERVATIVE_COST) drives the sleeve's cash/equity reality per plan section 6; LINEAGE_COST tracks identical quantities with lineage fee/slippage/funding parameters and is exposed via equity_view
ledger crash residue (torn trailing line or invalid JSON) refuses all further reads AND appends; committed bytes are never rewritten or truncated
